+title: 'Web: add WebCapability, the search and fetch verbs, and withWeb'
+---
+## What
+Mount the web capability in code mode, the same way as `files`. Design: `web.md` § "The surface", § "Corrections, not throws", § "Configuration" (the builder short form), and § "Mount in code mode". Decisions 2, 3, and 5: `search` never fetches pages; both verbs are synchronous (no `BackgroundTool`); `withWeb()` defaults to `.fromEnvironment()`.
+
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Capabilities/Web/WebContext.swift`: `final class WebContext` holds one `WebFetcher`, one `WebPageReader`, and one `WebSearchChain`, all made from a `WebConfiguration` and a `URLSessionConfiguration`. It maps each `WebSearchProvider` case to its adapter.
+- `.../Web/WebCapability.swift`: `public struct WebCapability: Capability` with `noun = "web"` and `tools = [Search(context:), Fetch(context:)]`, modelled on `Capabilities/Files/FilesCapability.swift`.
+- `.../Web/Search.swift`: `@Generable SearchArguments` (`query`, `count`, `freshness`, `site`), `@Generable SearchResult` (`provider`, `results: [WebHit]`, `notes`, `correction`), `struct Search: Tool` with `name = "search"`. Bounds: query trimmed, 1 to 500 characters; count 1 to 20 (default 10); freshness `day|week|month|year` through `EnumParameter` (`Capabilities/Files/EnumParameter.swift:51`).
+- `.../Web/Fetch.swift`: `@Generable FetchArguments` (`url`, `format`, `offset`, `maxCharacters`, `timeout`), `@Generable FetchResult` (`url`, `status`, `contentType`, `title`, `content`, `totalCharacters`, `nextOffset`, `correction`), `struct Fetch: Tool` with `name = "fetch"`. Bounds: `maxCharacters` 500 to 200000 (default 20000); `timeout` 1 to 120 (default 30); `offset` ≥ 0; format `markdown|text|raw`.
+- The `description` of each verb tells the model when to use it, that `search` then `fetch` in one snippet is the normal pattern, and that `Promise.all` fetches pages in parallel.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsMultitool/Surface/MultiToolBuilder.swift`: add `withWeb(configuration: WebConfiguration = .fromEnvironment(), sessionConfiguration: URLSessionConfiguration = .ephemeral) -> Self` beside `withFiles` (`:285`), with a doc comment in the style of `withFiles`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `withWeb` renders exactly `tools.web.search` and `tools.web.fetch`; a builder with no `withWeb` renders no `web` entry.
+- [ ] A second `withWeb` is `.duplicateNoun` at `buildRegistry()`.
+- [ ] `searchTools`, `help()`, and `docs()` find both verbs.
+- [ ] Each bad argument gives a `correction` and does not throw; a failed search or fetch gives a `correction`; a non-2xx page is a normal result.
+- [ ] Neither verb declares `BackgroundTool`: each call answers inline.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Create `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/WebCapabilityTests.swift`, modelled on `FilesCapabilityTests.swift` (noun, two verbs, one shared context, render, no entries without `withWeb`, `.duplicateNoun`, `searchTools`, `help()`, `docs()`, inline mount).
+- [ ] Create `Tests/FoundationModelsMultitoolTests/WebVerbArgumentTests.swift`: each bound and enum value of both verbs gives the correct correction text; a stubbed search and a stubbed fetch give the documented result shapes.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter "WebCapabilityTests|WebVerbArgumentTests"`. All pass. Then run `swift test`.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #web
\ No newline at end of file
